answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 7180 Country: AF Title: There are some bald Muslims who wear a wig (artificial hair) (2) or undergo a surgary for hair transplant. is it allowed or not? Question: There are some bald Muslims who wear a wig (artificial hair) (2) or undergo a surgary for hair transplant. is it allowed or not? May Allah bless us all. Answer ID: 7180 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 819/819=M/1429) One can wear artificial hair provided it is not human hair and not impure. (2) It is not allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
